findings.description: unique_by returns the last item per key due to dict override behavior, but the contract demands the first item for each distinct key.
findings.evidence: Input: items=[{'id':1,'value':'first'},{'id':1,'value':'second'}], key=lambda x: x['id']. Expected output: [{'id':1,'value':'first'}]. Candidate output: [{'id':1,'value':'second'}].

review.summary: The implementation returns the last item for each key instead of the first, violating the contract that requires the first occurrence to be retained.
